title: Bug 629779: [Inventory] Show a single Export/Import item data action pair on Cost Adjustment and Item Card
summary: The Cost Adjustment and Item Card pages now show a single Export/Import action pair that automatically switches between standard inventory and manufacturing data formats based on whether the Manufacturing module is enabled, eliminating duplicate and confusing action options.
key_points: Pages detect Manufacturing enablement at runtime and display only the relevant Export/Import pair
Captions simplified to show only 'Export item data' and 'Import item data' regardless of module
Manufacturing-enabled installations route to production data XMLPorts while standard installations use standard XMLPorts
Change applied across Cost Adjustment Overview, Manufacturing Cost Adjustment Overview extension, Item Card, and Manufacturing Item Card extension
No schema or public API changes, purely UI-level caption and visibility adjustments
